scope: Source-only review of quote-bearing header and Data T03 naming paths. No browser, test, build, or product edits.

data_manual_flow.source: docs/stabilization/inventory.json: EXT-F-2005-T03 describes picking fields, naming/saving the pattern, then running and copying extracted rows.
data_manual_flow.picker: src/lib/data-pattern/picker.ts assigns each pick the generated name field_N when reporting results; its overlay offers Done, Cancel, and Clear only. It has no field-name editor.
data_manual_flow.data_view: src/features/data/DataView.tsx renders selected field names as text and allows naming the overall pattern; saved patterns expose Run and copy actions, with no field rename action.
data_manual_flow.conclusion: Ordinary Data controls cannot create a straight-quote field name/header. The user can name the pattern itself, which is not an extracted column header. Do not invent a click path or inject a fixture.

evidence.separate_ui: src/features/showcase/tabs/AiExtractTab.tsx does expose editable output-schema field names, but that is Showcase AI Extract, not the Data manual-field lifecycle in EXT-F-2005-T03; it does not establish native Data-path acceptance.
evidence.existing_native_evidence: docs/stabilization/reports/tsv-quote-native.json proves real quote-bearing cell values and spreadsheet paste on the AFI page, while explicitly leaving quote-bearing headers and Data T03 unverified.

multiline_value_target.recommendation: Use a single stanza/poem-sized element from Project Gutenberg's public HTML for The Raven as a genuine multiline value, instead of capturing an entire novel.
multiline_value_target.bound: One stanza-sized field is only a few hundred characters, suitable for an ordinary spreadsheet cell; the page is a short poem rather than a 719k-character book.
multiline_value_target.qualification: Source recommendation only; not exercised in the browser. Confirm the selected DOM element yields embedded line breaks through the ordinary manual CSS extraction flow before treating it as native evidence.
